name: Création facture de cotisation
script:
customer_group_name = frappe.form_dict.get('unit')

if not customer_group_name:
    frappe.throw("Customer Group Name is required.")

# Fetch all customers in the specified customer group
customers = frappe.get_all('Customer', filters={'customer_group': customer_group_name}, fields=['name'])

if not customers:
    frappe.throw(f"No customers found in the Customer Group: {customer_group_name}")

# Calculate the from_date and to_date
current_year = frappe.utils.now_datetime().year
from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.get_first_day(f"{current_year}-10-01"))  # October 1st of the current year
to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.get_last_day(f"{current_year + 1}-09-30"))  # September 30th of the next year
added_invoices = []

# Loop through all customers in the customer group to create invoices
for customer in customers:
    try:
        # Check if there is already an invoice for the same year containing the item "Cotisation"
        existing_invoice = frappe.get_all('Sales Invoice', filters={
            'customer': customer['name'],
            'name': ['in', frappe.get_all('Sales Invoice Item', filters={'item_code': 'Cotisation'}, pluck='parent')],
            'from_date': from_date,
            'to_date': to_date,
            'docstatus': ['!=', 2]  # Exclude cancelled invoices
        })
        
        if existing_invoice:
            continue  # Skip if an invoice already exists for the same year

        # Create a new Sales Invoice document
        invoice = frappe.new_doc('Sales Invoice')
        invoice.customer = customer['name']
        invoice.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
        invoice.from_date = from_date
        invoice.to_date = to_date

        # Set cost center and payment terms template
        invoice.unité = customer_group_name
        invoice.payment_terms_template = "Versements cotisation"

        # Set the debit_to account from the customer group's default receivable account
        # invoice.debit_to = debit_to_account

        # Add the "Cotisation" item to the invoice
        invoice.append('items', {
            'item_code': 'Cotisation',
            'qty': 1,
            'unité': customer_group_name
        })

        # Insert the invoice as draft
        invoice.insert()
        added_invoices.append(invoice.name)

    except Exception as e:
        # Log any errors that occur during the process and continue
        frappe.log_error(f"Error creating invoice for customer {customer['name']}: {str(e)}", 'Invoice Creation Error')
        frappe.throw(e)

# Commit to the database after all invoices are successfully created
try:
    frappe.db.commit()
except Exception as e:
    # Log if any error occurs during commit
    frappe.log_error(f"Error committing invoices: {str(e)}", 'Invoice Commit Error')
    frappe.throw(f"An error occurred while committing invoices: {str(e)}")

# Output the created invoice names (rows)
frappe.response['invoices'] = added_invoices

name: lier les contacts au client
script:
# Séparer le nom du client pour correspondre potentiellement au prénom et au nom du contact
name_parts = doc.customer_name.split(' ', 1)

if len(name_parts) == 2:
    first_name = name_parts[0]
    last_name = name_parts[1]
else:
    first_name = name_parts[0]
    last_name = ''

# Chercher un contact avec le prénom et le nom séparés
contact = frappe.get_all('Contact', 
                         filters={'first_name': first_name, 'last_name': last_name}, 
                         fields=['name'])

# Si aucun contact n'est trouvé, chercher un contact avec le nom complet dans le champ 'first_name'
if not contact:
    contact = frappe.get_all('Contact', 
                             filters={'first_name': doc.customer_name}, 
                             fields=['name'])
                             
# Si aucun contact n'est trouvé, chercher un contact avec le nom complet dans le champ 'last_name'
if not contact:
    contact = frappe.get_all('Contact', 
                             filters={'last_name': doc.customer_name}, 
                             fields=['name'])

if contact:
    # Lier le contact trouvé au client
    frappe.get_doc({
        'doctype': 'Dynamic Link',
        'link_doctype': 'Customer',
        'link_name': doc.name,
        'parenttype': 'Contact',
        'parent': contact[0].name
    }).insert()
    frappe.msgprint(f'Contact {contact[0].name} lié au client {doc.customer_name}')
else:
    frappe.msgprint(f'Aucun contact trouvé pour {doc.customer_name}')
